label: Google's refusal of a key, as the one thing to change

params.name: invalid_message
params.default: Google refused that key. Copy it again from aistudio.google.com/apikey.

params.name: model_message
params.default: Your key works, but it cannot use "{model}". Pick another model.

params.name: network_message
params.default: This server could not reach Google (network, proxy or firewall). Your key is saved — try the test again once it can.

params.name: other_message
params.default: That key could not be used.

description_nl: The HTTP status and the sentence for each kind from narrator.key_error_kind. Google's own sentence is always attached (google_said), so the next failure explains itself. A network failure is 502: not the key's fault.

args.detail: 404 NOT_FOUND. models/gemini-9 is not found for API version v1beta

expect_value.message: Your key works, but it cannot use "gemini-9". Pick another model. [Google said: 404 NOT_FOUND. models/gemini-9 is not found for API version v1beta]
This server could not reach Google (network, proxy or firewall). Your key is saved — try the test again once it can. [Google said: Connection reset]

args.detail: 404 NOT_FOUND. Requested entity was not found.

expect_value.message: That key could not be used. [Google said: 404 NOT_FOUND. Requested entity was not found.]

weight_basis: Portal wording, no scoring. The knobs ARE the sentences — edit them here, never in Python.
